root_motivation: **Who.** An agent (Claude Code, an SDK client, a synthorg persona) that calls `host.catalog.search` to find a shared tool it can call instead of writing one; Joe reading the anonymous catalog as the public face of the host; the operator judging whether the catalog proves anything.
user_persona: An agent whose first SELECT names a table or column it has not declared, and must learn from the reply which table or column is missing and which declared names are closest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a tenant with a published tool, When host.tool_test, or require_tested on host.tool_share, returns pass or will_fail on the current version, Then the row stores that verdict with the version it judged, tested_version moves exactly as today, after a republish the entry shows test_verdict null and the tool ranks as untested until retested, and catalog.search shows test_verdict only when it judged the current version.

Given tools of a synthetic-marked, a disabled and a plain owner shared public, When the well-known document is read and a plain and another synthetic-marked tenant each call catalog.search and tool_list_shared, Then the anonymous and plain reads list only the plain owner's tool, the synthetic tenant's reads add the synthetic owner's tool, none lists the disabled owner's tool, and include_synthetic is in the contract dump.

Given a public tool called by its owner, twice by a plain tenant (one ok, one error), once by a synthetic-marked tenant and once 31 days ago, When a plain caller searches, Then the entry carries calls_30d n 2 ok 1; a synthetic-marked caller sees n 3 ok 2; the old call counts in neither; and no entry carries a caller or tenant id, only the owner namespace.

Given five plain owners' public tools A pass 1/1, B pass 95/100, C untested with no calls, D republished after a pass then tested will_fail with 100/100, E equal to C but shared later, all calls by plain tenants, When a sixth plain tenant runs catalog.search and tool_list_shared and the well-known document is read, Then all three return the order B, A, E, C, D, ordered by the one search_catalog SQL.

Given the committed host-output-schemas.v1.json, When a test serializes a fully populated catalog.search result, Then at every level, including tools.items, calls_30d and view, every emitted key is declared and every declared key is emitted, each of those objects sets additionalProperties false, and removing any emitted field, nested or not, from the schema fails the test naming the key path.

Given 1,000 public tools over 300 owners and 100,000 calls rows seeded in a test, When 8 concurrent callers search with no q, a q matching nothing and limit 50, Then no q returns 50 entries with view.owners counting the distinct owners in the view, the no-match q returns tools [] with view present, and p95 over 20 runs stays under 250 ms.

Given an in-process TestServer, When tests/live/tdisc_live_receipts_rank.py runs under python3 -I against its base_url/mcp, Then its last stdout line is `tdisc_live first=tested receipts=ok hidden=2 view=real offboarded rc=0`, it exits 0, both tenants it signed up are offboarded and no key is printed; against a closed loopback port its last line ends rc=2 and it exits 2.

Given prod after the deploy that carries this PRD, When the AC 8 command in § Live evidence commands runs from the build host, Then its last two lines are the driver's `rc=0` line and `rc=0` (Live; evidence: python3 -I tests/live/tdisc_live_receipts_rank.py https://mcphost.dev/mcp from the build host, last two lines tdisc_live first=tested receipts=ok hidden=2 view=real offboarded rc=0 and rc=0)

scope: src/tables.rs + src/query_diag.rs: classify a recognised rusqlite no-such-table / no-such-column error on the table SQL paths before the Storage conversion, with the diagnosis (table/column, candidates, hint, declared_tables_count) in the error data.
src/errors.rs + error registry + errors.json: new table_column_not_found code (family Table, AgentFault, non-retryable) in the INVALID_PARAMS arm; generated surfaces regenerated.
host-tools.v1.json descriptor for host.table.query and its generated docs, contract and SDKs.
non_goals: Changing the diagnosis algorithm or its bands; SQL dialect help; touching host.state.* behaviour; any change to query_log rows.

additional.no_schema_change: Wire-only change; query_log schema unchanged and there is no migration.

five_whys_trace.q: Why did dpb_03 get an internal error on its first SELECT?
five_whys_trace.a: The no-such-table rusqlite error became AppError::Storage and every Storage error is swapped for the internal-error reply.

five_whys_trace.q: Why was the cause not on the wire?
five_whys_trace.a: diagnose_sync computed candidates and a hint but filed them only in query_log.
The shipped query-diagnosis PRD had no AC on the error branch.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which tables does candidates draw from?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The tenant's declared tables from list_table_names_sync, as today; other-namespace shared tables are not included.
